example.cn: 他决定把余生奉献给科学研究。

example.cn: 愤怒的示威者要求两名高级官员辞职。

example.cn: 她手表上的夜光表面显示时间为1点20分。

example.cn: 他告诉警察的话和告诉他母亲的不同。

example.cn: 哈布斯堡王朝在1278至1918年间统治奥地利。

cn: 困境；进退两难；两刀论法

example.cn: 道德上进退两难的窘境

example.cn: 他和朋友在里茨饭店一起进餐。

example.cn: 我希望今年能拿到教师证书。

example.cn: 这家公司由董事会管理。

example.cn: 供残疾人使用的设施仍然不足。

example.cn: 可以从因特网上免费下载的游戏

enDef: someone who is diligent works hard and is careful and thorough

example.cn: 木头是耐用材料。

example.cn: 阴暗邋遢的房间

enDef: the state of being untidy or not organized

example.en: The nation is in disarray following rioting led by the military.
example.cn: 该国发生由军队发动的暴乱后，陷入一片混乱。

enDef: a lot of rain that falls in a short time

example.en: ...sheltering from a sudden downpour of rain.
example.cn: …躲避一场突如其来的瓢泼大雨。

enDef: dull and making you feel sad or bored

example.en: the same dreary routine
example.cn: 一成不变的、乏味的日常事务

enDef: to make something or someone extremely wet

example.en: In the early morning they had got drenched in the grass.
example.cn: 一大清早他们在草丛里弄得浑身湿透。

enDef: to be in a light sleep or to feel as though you are almost asleep

example.en: I was drowsing in front of the television when you called.
example.cn: 我正坐在电视机前打瞌睡，恰好你打电话来。

cn: 苦工，重活，单调乏味的工作
enDef: hard boring work

example.en: We cannot hope for cheap food, but we can improve skills, boost productivity, reduce drudgery and enhance people's quality of life.
example.cn: 我们不能把希望放在廉价食品上，但是我们可以改善技能，促进生产力，减少单调的苦工，并提高人们的生活质量。

enDef: a very small drop of liquid

example.en: Droplets of sweat were welling up on his forehead.
example.cn: 一颗颗小汗珠从他额头上不断冒出来。

cn: 使失去方向感； 使迷茫， 使不知所措
enDef: If something disorientates you, you lose your sense of direction, or you generally feel lost and uncertain, for example, because you are in an unfamiliar environment

example.en: An overnight stay at a friend's house disorientates me.
example.cn: 在朋友家睡了一觉，醒来我不知自己身在何处。

enDef: Departmental is used to describe the activities, responsibilities, or possessions of a department in a government, company, or other organization

example.en: The Secretary of Education is right to seek a bigger departmental budget.
example.cn: 教育部长寻求更多的部门预算是对的。

enDef: Decompression is the reduction of the force on something that is caused by the weight of the air

example.en: Decompression blew out a window in the plane.
example.cn: 机舱内减压吹掉了一块玻璃窗。

cn: 幻灭； 觉醒， 醒悟
enDef: Disillusionment is the disappointment that you feel when you discover that something is not as good as you had expected or thought

example.en: Polls have charted growing disillusionment with the campaign.
example.cn: 民意调查显示人们对这场运动越来越失望。

enDef: not polite, and not showing respect for other people

example.en: It would be discourteous to ignore his request.
example.cn: 忽视他的请求是失礼的。

enDef: a situation in which a disagreement cannot be settled

example.en: The talks have reached a complete deadlock .
example.cn: 会谈完全陷入僵局。

enDef: To deplete a stock or amount of something means to reduce it

example.en: ...substances that deplete the ozone layer.
example.cn: …消耗臭氧层的物质。

enDef: a derelict building or piece of land is in very bad condition because it has not been used for a long time

example.en: Her body was found dumped in a derelict warehouse less than a mile from her home.
example.cn: 她的尸体被发现丢在离她家不到一英里的一座废弃的仓库里。

enDef: behaving in a way that is illegal or that society does not approve of

example.en: ...a legal shortcut to take homes from delinquent borrowers.
example.cn: …一个取得拖欠贷款者房产的法律捷径。

enDef: disagreement or arguing between people

example.en: marital discord
example.cn: 婚姻不和

enDef: a complete lack of respect that you show for someone or something because you think they are not important or good enough

example.en: a look of complete disdain
example.cn: 极为鄙视的样子

enDef: to make something go away, especially a belief, idea, or feeling

example.en: We want to dispel the myth that you cannot eat well in Britain.
example.cn: 我们要消除在英国吃不好的误解。

cn: 令人沮丧的， 使人气馁的
enDef: Something that is dispiriting causes you to lose your enthusiasm and excitement

example.en: It's very dispiriting for anyone to be out of a job.
example.cn: 对每个人来说，没有工作都令人沮丧。

enDef: in the proper or expected way

example.en: Here are your travel documents, all duly signed.
example.cn: 这是你的旅行证件，都签好了。

enDef: to gradually become less and less or smaller and smaller

example.en: The elephant population is dwindling.
example.cn: 大象的数量在减少。

enDef: to reduce the value of one country’s money when it is exchanged for another country’s money

example.en: Nigeria has just devalued its currency .
example.cn: 尼日利亚刚刚令自己的货币贬值。

enDef: a unit for measuring the loudness of sound

example.en: noise levels exceeding 85 decibels
example.cn: 超过85分贝的噪声强度

enDef: to spoil the appearance that something naturally has

example.en: His face had been disfigured in an accident.
example.cn: 在一次意外事故中他毁了容。

enDef: If one thing detracts from another, it makes it seem less good or impressive

example.en: They feared that the publicity surrounding him would detract from their own election campaigns.
example.cn: 他们担心围绕他的宣传会有损他们自已的竞选活动。

cn: 分发， 分配； 提供
enDef: to give something to people, especially in fixed amounts

example.en: a machine for dispensing cash
example.cn: 取款机

cn: 碎裂， 瓦解， 解体
enDef: to break up, or make something break up, into very small pieces

example.en: The plane just disintegrated in mid-air.
example.cn: 飞机就在半空中解体了。

cn: 挖掘； 疏浚； 挖出， 吸出； 重提旧事
enDef: to remove mud or sand from the bottom of a river,  harbour  etc, or to search for something by doing this

example.en: They dredged for oysters.
example.cn: 他们在挖牡蛎。

enDef: When someone is disqualified, they are officially stopped from taking part in a particular event, activity, or competition, usually because they have done something wrong

example.en: Thomson was disqualified from the 400 metre freestyle.
example.cn: 汤姆森被取消了400米自由泳的参赛资格。

enDef: Disenchantment is the feeling of being disappointed with something, and no longer believing that it is good or worthwhile

example.en: There is growing public disenchantment with the educational system.
example.cn: 公众对教育制度越来越感到希望幻灭。

cn: 贬抑， 贬低； 轻蔑， 轻视
enDef: to criticize someone or something in a way that shows you do not think they are very good or important

example.en: Matcham’s theatres were widely disparaged by architects.
example.cn: 马彻姆设计的剧院遭到了建筑师的普遍抨击。

cn: 消化的； 和消化有关的
enDef: connected with the process of digestion

example.en: ...digestive juices that normally work on breaking down our food.
example.cn: …通常用于分解食物的消化液。

cn: 拆除； 破坏， 毁坏
enDef: The demolition of a structure, for example, a building, is the act of deliberately destroying it, often in order to build something else in its place

example.en: The project required the total demolition of the old bridge.
example.cn: 这项工程要求那座旧桥的彻底拆除。

enDef: to think that someone or their behaviour, ideas etc are bad or wrong

example.en: I knew my parents would disapprove, but I went anyway.
example.cn: 我知道父母会反对，但我还是去了。

cn: 散布， 分散； 消散， 疏散
enDef: the process of spreading things over a wide area or in different directions

example.en: the role of birds in the dispersal of seeds
example.cn: 鸟类对传播种子的作用

cn: 使怀疑； 使丧失信誉， 使丢脸
enDef: To discredit someone or something means to cause them to lose people's respect or trust

example.en: ...a secret unit within the company that had been set up to discredit its major rival.
example.cn: …为破坏其主要竞争对手声誉而设的一个公司内秘密单位。

cn: 不满意的， 不满足的
enDef: not satisfied because something is not as good as you had expected

example.en: dissatisfied clients
example.cn: 感到不满意的客户

cn: 停止； 中断； 不连续
enDef: to stop doing, producing, or providing something

example.en: Bus route 51 is being discontinued.
example.cn: 51 路公共汽车目前停止运营。

enDef: a situation in which there are very few of something that people want or need

example.en: Construction had slowed because of a dearth of labourers.
example.cn: 建筑进程缓慢是因为劳动力不足。

enDef: to find the meaning of something that is difficult to read or understand

example.en: She studied the envelope, trying to decipher the handwriting.
example.cn: 她仔细地看信封，试图辨认上面的字迹。

enDef: old and in bad condition

example.en: The buildings were in a decrepit state.
example.cn: 这些建筑物破旧不堪。

cn: 献身的，一心一意的，热诚的

example.en: a dedicated and thoughtful teacher
example.cn: 一位富有敬业精神、待人体贴的教师

enDef: to stop someone from doing something, by making them realize it will be difficult or have bad results

example.en: The company’s financial difficulties have deterred potential investors.
example.cn: 该公司的财务困境令潜在的投资者望而却步。

enDef: a liquid or powder used for washing clothes, dishes etc

example.en: ...a brand of detergent.
example.cn: …一种品牌的清洁剂。

enDef: to hate something or someone very much

example.en: The two men detested each other.
example.cn: 两个男人互相厌恶。

enDef: harm or damage

example.en: Work hard to succeed but not to the detriment of others.
example.cn: 在不损害他人利益的前提下为成功艰苦奋斗。

enDef: causing harm or damage

example.en: the detrimental effect of pollution on the environment
example.cn: 污染对环境的不利影响

cn: (博士学位)论文，学术演讲，专题论文
enDef: a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree

example.en: He is currently writing a dissertation on the Somali civil war.
example.cn: 他正在写一篇关于索马里内战的论文。

enDef: to swell or make something swell because of pressure from inside

example.en: Through this incision, the abdominal cavity is distended with carbon dioxide gas.
example.cn: 通过此切口，二氧化碳气体把胸腔充得肿胀起来。

enDef: If a liquid such as whisky or water is distilled, it is heated until it changes into steam or vapour and then cooled until it becomes liquid again. This is usually done in order to make it pure.

example.en: The whisky had been distilled in 1926 and sat quietly maturing until 1987.
example.cn: 这瓶威士忌是1926年被蒸馏的，存放至1987年酿造成熟。

cn: 人口统计学的； 人口的

example.en: In the same demographic breakdown of people may have different characteristics of the consumer mentality.
example.cn: 处于同一人口统计细分的人们，可能具有不同的消费心态特征。

enDef: someone who is tricked, especially into becoming involved in something illegal

example.en: He was accused of being a dupe of the Americans.
example.cn: 他被控是美国人的傀儡。

enDef: related to the food someone eats

example.en: special dietary requirements
example.cn: 特殊的饮食要求

example.en: Do you lose your balance because of dizziness or do you ever lose consciousness?
example.cn: 你曾否因为头昏眼花而失却平衡或你曾否失去知觉？

cn: 文件证据， 文献资料， 文件
enDef: official documents, reports etc that are used to prove that something is true or correct

example.en: Applicants must provide supporting documentation .
example.cn: 申请人必须提供证明文件。

cn: 制造混乱的； 分裂性的； 破坏性的
enDef: causing problems and preventing something from continuing in its usual way

example.en: Mike’s parents thought I was a disruptive influence (= a person who causes disruption ) .
example.cn: 迈克的父母认为我是个捣蛋分子。

cn: 过失； 缺点， 短处
enDef: a bad quality or feature of something

example.en: Demerits were given to students for late attendance at prayers.
example.cn: 祷告会上迟到的学生被记过了。

cn: 判断力； 谨慎， 审慎； 明智
enDef: the ability to deal with situations in a way that does not offend, upset, or embarrass people or tell any of their secrets

example.en: British newspapers no longer feel they must treat the royal family with discretion.
example.cn: 英国报界不再觉得他们非得审慎对待王室不可了。

cn: 动乱； 打乱； 破坏
enDef: a situation in which something is prevented from continuing in its usual way

example.en: The strike caused widespread disruption .
example.cn: 罢工造成了大规模的混乱。

cn: 驯养， 教化； 使喜爱家居生活
enDef: to make an animal able to work for people or live with them as a pet

example.en: We domesticated the dog to help us with hunting.
example.cn: 我们驯养狗来帮助我们打猎。

cn: 三角洲； 希腊字母表的第四个字母
enDef: an area of low land where a river spreads into many smaller rivers near the sea

example.en: the Nile delta
example.cn: 尼罗河三角洲

cn: 休眠； 催眠状态； 冬眠； 隐匿

enDef: to make a detour

example.en: When I go to the neighborhood, see in the road, so I made a detour, from another trail walk home.
example.cn: 当我走到居委会时，看到前面在修路，于是我绕道而行，从另外一条小路走回家。

cn: 有识别力的， 眼光敏锐的
enDef: showing the ability to make good judgments, especially about art, music, style etc

example.en: an ideal tour for the discerning traveller
example.cn: 对具鉴赏品位的游客而言一次理想之旅

cn: 抢夺， 掠夺； 蹂躏， 破坏
enDef: to make a place much less attractive by removing or damaging things

example.en: ...people who despoil the countryside.
example.cn: ...掠夺乡村的人。

enDef: relating to one of the parts into which a large organization, group etc is divided

example.en: divisional headquarters
example.cn: 师指挥部

example.en: He had their own uniqueness and vitality, and dissemination of a value concept.
example.cn: 他有了自己的独特性和生命力，并传播一种价值理念。

enDef: If you are disrespectful, you show no respect in the way that you speak or behave to someone

example.en: ...accusations that he had been disrespectful to a police officer.
example.cn: ...关于他曾对一名警官无礼的控告。
